name: Kaamui
description: Kaamui was a terrestrial planet that was the homeworld of the master of the droid Teto. At some point, Kaamui was destroyed by a war, and Teto escaped with his master aboard a starship designed to resemble the planet. At least hundreds of years later, Teto met the human Lah Kara aboard the now-abandoned ship and told her of their escape from the war on Kaamui.
